redesign.subtitle: See what moves your opportunities forward.
redesign.cohort_definition: The interval selects opportunities by when they were added. Evidence through the displayed cutoff is included; recent opportunities may still progress later.
redesign.reply_definition: Confirmed human replies divided by contacted opportunities. Automatic acknowledgments and status-only changes are excluded.
redesign.progression_definition: Unique contacted opportunities with event evidence that they reached Negotiation.
redesign.reply_timing_definition: Calendar days from first outbound contact to first dated human reply. Undated replies still count toward reply rate.
redesign.dated_reply_sample: Based on {count, plural, one {# dated reply} other {# dated replies}}
redesign.stage_caption: Cumulative unique opportunities; each bar uses the full cohort.
redesign.stage_history_gaps: {count, plural, one {# record has} other {# records have}} a current progressed status or Closing event without supporting Negotiation history; excluded from progression.
redesign.time_caption: First outbound contact to first confirmed human reply.
redesign.duration_coverage: {dated} dated · {undated} undated · {pending} pending · {invalid} invalid date pairs. Undated, pending, and invalid pairs are excluded from duration.
redesign.source_caption: Counts and progression share the same cohort. Small samples can swing quickly.
redesign.record_count: {count, plural, one {# record} other {# records}} in this filtered cohort
